profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Ent
profile.summary: An Intelligence and Risk Management Professional with a combined 12 years’ military and private sector experience in threat monitoring, intelligence collection management, time-sensitive reporting, and operational risk and compliance consulting. Passionate about helping clients make well-informed risk decisions that complement their business goals. Bringing a growth-centric mindset to an information security role, with special interest in Identity and Access Management, Security, and Compliance in the Cloud.

positions.title: Director of Intelligence
positions.description:
My proven track record with the KBLA led to promotions and expanded concurrent roles performing operational threat monitoring and executive briefing with Erudite Risk, an affiliated risk consultancy.

- Created, designed and published two different weekly risk intelligence reports, which generated approximately $100K in monthly revenue 

- Provided threat monitoring, business continuity and crisis response planning, and executive briefings for over 50 multinationals during the 2017-2018 North Korea crisis 

- Served over a dozen executive protection details with risk intelligence support in advance of the 2018 Winter Olympics in Pyeongchang, South Korea 

- Used OSINT techniques to conduct over 100 Korean-language due diligence investigations for international clients to ensure compliance with Foreign Corrupt Practices Act 

- Participated in long-term security and compliance audits on the local branches of three large multinational entities. Roles included document review, document translation, drafting reports of audit findings, and briefing international stakeholders

- Conducted physical penetration test to assess security posture of a large food processing plant; identified and reported major flaws and provided suggestions for remediation  

- Published routine reporting for stakeholders regarding updates to South Korea’s Personal Information Protection Act and Location Information Act, as well as the European Union’s General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).
positions.insights: Skills: Cybersecurity · Information Security · Analytical Skills

positions.title: Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
I designed, drafted, and published four different subscription-based, weekly intelligence reports read by country managers and top executives from 150 multinational companies with interests in Korea. Topics included macroeconomic data, sector-specific trends, operational and regulatory risk, and cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

- Created and curated a set of over 50 authoritative Korean-language primary sources which I routinely monitored for data and key developments

- Wrote ten SOPs on Korea-specific OSINT techniques and trained five junior analysts

positions.title: Contributor and Analyst
positions.description:
As a contributing analyst with NK (North Korea) News, I contributed nine articles for publication, focusing primarily on developments with North Korean unmanned aerial vehicles and the South Korean defense industry.

https://www.nknews.org/author-bio/?author=kyle-johnson

positions.title: Senior Signals Intelligence Analyst, Senior Mission Manager, Korean Linguist
positions.description:
I served in both strategic and field military intelligence units with distinction in analytical, training, and managerial roles. I specialized in threat monitoring, network traffic analysis, and technical report writing. 

- Promoted from desk analyst to Senior Mission Manager for a field station of 40 analysts in less than six months; superior performance led to promotion to higher echelon intelligence unit 

- Created and implemented a mission orientation training program, personally trained over two dozen incoming analysts, and reduced time spent on quality assurance by 50%

- Handpicked to establish a specialized analytical cell in a subordinate organization; drafted six SOPs, trained 12 analysts, and led new cell to full mission capability in less than one month

- Created novel reporting vehicle which enabled wider dissemination of actionable intelligence to operational teams; increased team intelligence production by 300% and made ours the most productive of 10 teams

- Conducted digital forensics acquisition and analysis on over 100 devices; responsible for chain of custody on hundreds of additional pieces of media
